Good meat
Nov 2025 • Family
A fusion restaurant with a well-crafted menu.
I visited twice with my family in November, and during our second visit we noticed that some prices had increased , though the dishes, especially the meats, are still very affordable. 

The meat quality is very good for what you pay, and it’s definitely worth spending a bit more to choose one of the top cuts, such as the tenderloin.

The gnocchi are outstanding.

The pastas, however — we tried the crab sauce, the seafood pasta, and the rigatoni — were just average. They could improve the cooking, as the pasta wasn’t properly al dente.

The best fusion restaurant in Danang
Apr 2025 • Couples
Nấm De Cuisine is a fantastic spot in Đà Nẵng that truly stands out with its unique fusion concept. The restaurant blends local flavors with global cooking techniques, creating dishes that feel both fresh and familiar. It’s the kind of place where you can enjoy a twist on traditional Vietnamese food without it feeling forced or overly complicated.

One of my favorites is the Go Local dish. It takes classic Vietnamese ingredients and presents them in a new, exciting way while still keeping the flavors authentic. It’s a great showcase of local produce and spices but with a creative touch that makes it stand out.

Another highlight is the Meat Platter. For anyone who loves meat, this is a must-try. The meats are perfectly cooked, tender, and packed with flavor, complemented by well-thought-out sides that balance everything out. It’s clear that Chef Thuc, the talented chef behind the dishes, knows exactly how to handle both traditional and contemporary flavors with precision.

Speaking of Chef Thuc, his expertise really shines through in every dish. You can tell he’s passionate about what he does, and the quality and creativity in his food reflect that. Each plate is carefully crafted, with the right balance of seasoning, texture, and presentation.

The restaurant itself is in a great location, easy to get to, and has a spacious parking lot—always a plus in Đà Nẵng. The atmosphere is welcoming and modern, making it perfect for anything from a casual dinner to a special occasion.

Overall, Nấm De Cuisine offers an exceptional dining experience with delicious food, a talented chef, and a lovely setting. If you’re in Đà Nẵng and looking for something unique yet authentic, it’s definitely worth a visit.
